packageRules.description: Security fixes only: every other update is off, npm packages, GitHub Actions and Docker images alike (vulnerabilityAlerts overrides this rule)

Next 16 is a migration that comes with the v3: no next above 15. Only GitHub alerts keep this cap: an OSV alert sets its own allowedVersions after these rules and can still open a 16.x PR, to close until the v3
Tailwind CSS 4 needs a migration (postcss plugin, config, CSS entry): stay on v3. Same limit as next: an OSV alert can still open a 4.x PR, to close until the v3
